title: Blasted Lands
body: The Blasted Lands were once the southern half of the Black Morass. Here Medivh and the warlocks of the Shadow Council opened the Dark Portal, and the energies of the gate dried and warped the land into a red waste where lightning flickers without end and even the beasts have grown unnaturally strong. The Kirin Tor raised Nethergarde Keep in the northern hills to watch the gate, but the demons never truly left: the Legion's soldiers gather in the Tainted Scar, and a dreadlord called the Defiler rules the wastes through his cult.

parts.body: The Dark Portal itself stands dark and silent. For twenty years no army has passed through it, and the riftwatchers of Nethergarde never take their eyes from it.
A new shadow has fallen over the wastes: necropolises of the Scourge hang in the red sky above the heart of the Blasted Lands, spreading their dead across the land.
Now the Dark Portal has woken. Demons pour through it in an endless tide, and at its foot the Argent Dawn fights a desperate battle beside the mages of Nethergarde and champions of both factions.
The demons were driven back through the gate, and now the Alliance and the Horde march through the wastes and on into Outland, where a savage war rages on the far side.

title: Nethergarde Keep
body: Nethergarde Keep stands in the northern hills of the Blasted Lands, a Dalaranian fortress raised after the Second War at the urging of Archmage Khadgar to guard against any new invasion through the Dark Portal. The Kirin Tor have manned it ever since. It lives on supplies sent the long way from Darkshire, too many of which go astray, and an ambassador within its walls urges the Alliance to stop quarreling with the Horde and face the true enemy.

parts.body: When demons surged through the gate again, the keep's defenders held its foot beside the Argent Dawn, and now Nethergarde sends every soldier it can through to the war on the far side.

title: Dreadmaul Hold
body: In the northwest corner of the wastes squats Dreadmaul Hold, an orc settlement until the Dreadmaul ogres drove the orcs out after the Second War and gave it their own name. The Dreadmaul came from Draenor through the Dark Portal and have never strayed far from it; their mounds dot the wastes toward the gate. Here their lord, Grol the Destroyer, holds court beside a stone of binding.

title: The Serpent's Coil
body: The Serpent's Coil is a winding cave system in the eastern wastes, its mouth ringed by the burnt-out shells of orcish buildings left from the Second War. Shadowsworn cultists guard it for Archmage Allistarj, master of the labyrinth, and a great fel beast called Kirith the Damned prowls its back cave, burning away the magic of all who face it.

parts.body: The beast was once Kirith, lieutenant of Thrall's Grasp. Allistarj imprisoned him beside his captured commander and tortured them both, until Kirith's will gave way and the experiments made a monster of him. Only in death could his spirit speak again.

title: The Dark Portal
body: The Dark Portal looms over the southern wastes, the colossal gate through which the orcish Horde first came to Azeroth. Shattered at the end of the Second War, it woke once more for a short while when the Alliance marched through it into Draenor, and was then destroyed from the far side. Felguard sentries and felhounds roam its approaches.

parts.body: Twenty years have passed since then, and the gate stands dark and silent, a monument to wars half forgotten, watched day and night from Nethergarde.
Now the gate has woken. Demons pour through it in an endless tide, and the Argent Dawn calls on every hero to enter the breach beside the mages of Nethergarde.
The demons were driven back, and the camps at its foot are calm now. Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane and Warlord Dar'toon send every soldier they can up the steps and through the gate.

title: The Tainted Scar
body: In the southwest of the wastes lies the Tainted Scar, where the portal's energies left the soil the color of blood. It is the Burning Legion's stronghold on this side of the gate. After the Legion's defeat at Mount Hyjal, Lord Kazzak led its remnants here, and felguards, dreadlords and doomguard commanders gather in strength. At an altar on its northern edge the aged warlock Daio the Decrepit lives among the demons, teaching others to bind them.

parts.body: Kazzak himself still holds the Scar, nursing the sting of defeat at the close of the Third War and swearing that the Legion's shadow will yet fall over this world.
Since the Dark Portal opened once more, the Legion in Outland has answered to him as Doom Lord Kazzak, and his lieutenants drive its war against the armies of Azeroth on the far side.

title: Razelikh the Defiler
body: Razelikh the Defiler is the dreadlord who rules the Blasted Lands. When the Legion's host was driven back into the Tainted Scar, Lord Kazzak sent him to bring the wastes to heel, and the Shadowsworn cult and the Dreadmaul ogres now do his bidding. His lair crowns the highest summit at the heart of the wastes, reachable only by runes of teleportation, and a spirit bound to this cursed land waits below it for those who would face him.

parts.body: Loramus Thalipedes told the rest. Razelikh, most feared of Kazzak's lieutenants, united the scattered Shadow Council with the Dreadmaul, and the stolen souls of Thrall's Grasp sealed the bargain: immortal servants for his three chief followers, in exchange for their eternal service.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Razelikh_the_Defiler (dreadlord, true name Rakh'likh, Kazzak's most fearsome lieutenant, tasked with securing the land, united the Shadow Council)

parts.body: The Defiler's true name is Rakh'likh, and once the shattered amulet his servants wore was whole again, his hunters could call him down by it.

parts.body: Razelikh fell on his summit with his champion Ilifar beside him, promising his slayers an eternity of anguish even as he died.

title: Kum'isha the Collector
body: Kum'isha the Collector is one of the Lost Ones, a draenei exile who lives in a crater near the Rise of the Defiler. He searches for flawless spheres of draenethyst, for with them he believes he can open a rift back to the world he lost. To his senses every race of Azeroth reeks of greed, and since greed cost him his home, he means to let greed carry him back.

parts.body: When a sphere reached him at last, he tore open a rift and cried out to his brethren to go home to Outland before it closed. Afterward, he remarked, one could see why he lives in a crater.
